goal: Create a 6-slide research presentation on climate tipping points. Slide 1: Title — 'Non-linear Climate Tipping Points: A Systems Analysis'. Slide 2: Background — what are tipping points (definition), why they matter (irreversibility), 3 key examples (AMOC collapse, Amazon dieback, West Antarctic Ice Sheet). Slide 6: Conclusion and Q&A invitation.
